key.name: location-mode
key.description: Where the Location comes from: the system's location services (automatic), or the Manual location, in which case the system is never asked where the user is.

key.name: manual-location
key.description: The Location entered by the user: name, then latitude and longitude in degrees (north and east positive).

key.name: last-known-location
key.description: The most recent Automatic location successfully obtained, used when the location mode provides none: name, then latitude and longitude in degrees (north and east positive).

key.name: reading
key.description: The duration shown in the top bar: the Remaining time until the next Solar event, or the Elapsed time since the last one.

key.name: twilight
key.description: How far below the horizon the Sun must be for the Dawn and Dusk shown in the menu: 6° (civil), 12° (nautical) or 18° (astronomical).

key.name: sun-arc-position
key.description: Which side of the Reading the Sun arc sits on in the top bar.

key.name: bar-content
key.description: What the indicator shows in the top bar: the Sun arc and the Reading, the Sun arc only, or the Reading only. The "Location unknown" and "Error" states always show their text.

key.name: indicator-position
key.description: Where the indicator sits in the top bar: just after the clock, at the end of the left side, or at the start of the right side.
